purpose: Persist successful Core-to-Foundation attestation-authority synchronisation receipts and surface stale or mismatched authority sync as Defence estate warning state.
invariants: Every successful authority-state publication records one append-only sync receipt after Foundation has validated or applied the authority state.
The receipt authority SHA, ref, workflow blob and lineage sequence must equal Foundation's current active authority at receipt time.
Scheduled heartbeats re-assert unchanged authority state and produce fresh receipts without duplicating authority activation history.
Authority activation and its sync receipt are atomic for promotion and rollback publications.
Missing, stale or authority-mismatched sync receipt is surfaced as warning in the full Defence estate summary.
Sync receipt history is not writable by public application roles.
